;0x000010e8;((self.$R=self.$R||{})["server-fn:0"]=[],($R=>$R[0]={question:$R[1]={id:1212633584,program:102,test:2,skill:4,difficulty:2,isLive:!1,multiChoice:!1,updateDate:$R[2]=new Date("2023-08-02T20:25:59.628Z"),createDate:$R[3]=new Date("2023-08-02T20:25:59.628Z"),externalId:null,ibn:"05268-DC",stem:"\x3Cp>A movie theater sells two types of tickets, adult tickets for $12 and child tickets for $8. If the theater sold 30&nbsp;tickets for a total&nbsp;of $300, how much, in dollars, was spent on adult tickets? (Disregard the $ sign when gridding your answer.)\x3C/p>",rationale:"\x3Cp>The correct answer is 180. Let \x3Cspan>a\x3C/span> be the number of adult tickets sold and \x3Cspan>c\x3C/span> be the number of child tickets sold. Since the theater sold a total of 30 tickets, \x3Cspan>a\x3C/span> + \x3Cspan>c\x3C/span> = 30. The price per adult ticket is $12, and the price per child ticket is $8. Since the theater received a total of $300 for the 30 tickets sold, it follows that 12\x3Cspan>a\x3C/span> + 8\x3Cspan>c\x3C/span> = 300. To eliminate \x3Cspan>c\x3C/span>, the first equation can be multiplied by 8 and then subtracted from the second equation:\x3Cbr> &nbsp; \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"12 a, plus 8 c, equals 300, and negative 8 a, minus 8 c, equals negative 240, gives 4 a, plus 0 c, equals 60\">\x3C/span>\x3C/p>\x3Cp>Because the question asks for the amount spent on adult tickets, which is 12\x3Cspan>a\x3C/span> dollars, the resulting equation can be multiplied by 3 to give 3(4\x3Cspan>a\x3C/span>) = 3(60) = 180. Therefore, $180 was spent on adult tickets.\x3C/p>\x3Cp>Alternate approach: If all the 30 tickets sold were child tickets, their total price would be 30($8) = $240. Since the actual total price of the 30 tickets was $300, the extra $60 indicates that a certain number of adult tickets, \x3Cspan>a\x3C/span>, were sold. Since the price of each adult ticket is $4 more than each child ticket, 4\x3Cspan>a\x3C/span> = 60, and it follows that 12\x3Cspan>a\x3C/span> = 180.\x3C/p>\x3Cp>\x3C/p>"},answers:$R[4]=[$R[5]={id:16258,question:1212633584,correct:!0,content:"180"}],userData:void 0})($R["server-fn:0"]))
